summary: Iteration 32: Approval Gate Verification - All 5 requirements verified. Scanner does NOT auto-dispatch, diagnose does NOT auto-dispatch, only approve triggers dispatch, scanner results use BC01-BC04 strategy codes, signals use ACTIVE allocation strategies.

✓ diagnose_pending_signal does NOT call _dispatch_signal_to_execution - adds 'manual_approval_gate_enforced' action
✓ approve_pending_signal DOES call _dispatch_signal_to_execution - only path to execution

context_for_next_testing_agent: Approval gate verification completed in iteration 32. All 5 requirements verified: (1) Scanner run creates pending signals but does NOT auto-dispatch, (2) Diagnose with auto_fix=true does NOT dispatch - adds 'manual_approval_gate_enforced' action, (3) Only approve endpoint triggers dispatch via _dispatch_signal_to_execution, (4) Scanner results have BC01-BC04 strategy codes from decision box map, (5) Signal strategy_code comes from ACTIVE allocation strategies.

requirement_1_scanner_no_auto_dispatch.evidence: Scanner run returns actionable_count=0, queued_count=0. Signals remain in status=pending, state=DETECTED/PENDING_APPROVAL with position_id=null. Code verification: run_user_scanner does NOT call _dispatch_signal_to_execution.

requirement_2_diagnose_no_auto_dispatch.evidence: Diagnose with auto_fix=true returns actions_applied=['status_contract_refresh_requested', 'manual_approval_gate_enforced']. Signal remains in status=pending, state=PENDING_APPROVAL with position_id=null. Code verification: diagnose_pending_signal does NOT call _dispatch_signal_to_execution.

requirement_3_only_approve_triggers_disp.evidence: Approve endpoint creates order intent (created_order_intent_id present). Code verification: approve_pending_signal DOES call _dispatch_signal_to_execution.

requirement_4_scanner_bc01_bc04_strategy.evidence: Scanner results show strategy_code in {BC01, BC02, BC03, BC04}. Example: HBARUSDT=BC02, GRTUSDT=BC04, BONKUSDT=BC04, XLMUSDT=BC03, DUSKUSDT=BC01. Code verification: _resolve_decision_box_code checks bc01-bc04 in order.

requirement_5_signal_active_allocation_s.evidence: Code verification: _list_active_allocation_strategy_ids filters by state=='ACTIVE'. _resolve_allocated_strategy_id resolves from active allocations. Signal strategy_code is set from allocated_strategy_id.
